The '''''Journal of Business & Economic Statistics''''' is a quarterly [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] published by the [[American Statistical Association]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Journals |url=https://www.amstat.org/publications/journals |access-date=2024-02-14 |website=Default}}</ref> The journal covers a broad range of applied problems in [[Business statistics|business]] and [[economic statistics]], including [[forecasting]], [[seasonal adjustment]], applied demand and cost analysis, applied [[econometric model]]ing, empirical finance, analysis of [[statistical survey|survey]] and [[longitudinal data]] related to business and economic problems, the impact of discrimination on wages and productivity, the returns to education and training, the effects of [[unionization]], and applications of stochastic [[control theory]] to business and economic problems.<ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1198/073500102753410345 |title=Editors' Introduction to Twentieth Anniversary Commemorative Issue of the Journal of Business and Economic Statistics |year=2002 |last1=Ghysels |first1=Eric |authorlink1=Eric Ghysels |last2=Hall |first2=Alastair |journal=Journal of Business & Economic Statistics |volume=20 |pages=1–4|s2cid=154033061 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1080/07350015.1983.10509314 |title=Editorial Statement |year=1983 |last1=Zellner |first1=Arnold |authorlink1=Arnold Zellner |journal=Journal of Business & Economic Statistics |volume=1 |pages=1–4}}</ref>
